title: Cost of goods consumed
summary: How much stock was used in the period, from the inventories and purchases.

opening-inventory.label: Opening inventory
opening-inventory.placeholder: Value of the stock at the start of the period (e.g. 125000)

purchases.label: Purchases in the period
purchases.placeholder: Total stock purchases in the period (e.g. 245000)

closing-inventory.label: Closing inventory
closing-inventory.placeholder: Value of the stock at the end of the period (e.g. 100000)
closing-inventory.hint: Value it with the same method as the opening inventory.

errors.closing-inventory.must-not-exceed-gross: The closing inventory can't exceed the opening inventory plus purchases.
